children: Nuburu's revenue rose from zero as the Orbit Change of Control and Lyocon Acquisition brought in sales; net loss narrowed year over year, with gains from changes in fair values and debt extinguishment offsetting operating losses and a $9.0M goodwill impairment.
¹ Reported as “Revenue”. ² Reported as “Net loss available to common stockholders”. ³ Reported as “Net loss per common share, diluted (1)”.
: Orbit contributed $200,043 and Lyocon $349,423 in revenue for the quarter.
: Recorded a non-cash $9.0M charge related to Orbit, citing a decline in market capitalization and results below acquisition expectations.
: Phase I development of a mobile additive-manufacturing platform began in 2026; $289,283 was recognized in R&D for the nine months ended September 30.
: After quarter-end, Nuburu completed the acquisition of a 70% controlling interest on October 15, 2026.
